title: Vehicle color preferences and choices
summary: Feedback centers on exterior and interior color appreciation, especially named black and gray options, with some mentions of wanting more color choice and one dislike of black lower-body trim.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the Brooklyn Gray and black color options, attractive color combinations, and satisfaction with seat and exterior colors.

negative.summary: Negative feedback is limited to a dislike of the black section below the doors because it does not match the rest of the vehicle color.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined comments mention color or ask for additional color choices, but the brief examples do not make the sentiment clear enough to classify as positive or negative.

limitations: Examples are sentiment-stratified and not a random sample, so they should not be treated as representative of all G60 feedback.
Several undetermined fragments are very brief or context-limited, which makes the underlying sentiment unclear.
The topic includes both concrete reactions to specific colors and broader requests for more color choices, so not every fragment reflects the same issue.
